== Notes ==
* Using a skill with the property "recharges instantly" will end Diversion ''without'' increasing that skill's recharge time.  This is also true of skills with a hidden instant recharge effect, such as [[Assassin attack chaining|Assassin chain attacks]] made without meeting the prerequisite.
* [[Inspired Hex]]/[[Revealed Hex]] will also end Diversion without increasing that skill's recharge time.
** If an affected target uses any other [[List of hex removal skills|hex removal]], Diversion will still activate and increase the recharge time of the hex removal skill.
* Preventing a skill from being ''diverted'' (especially in [[PvP]]) is one of the main uses of [[cancel]]ling.
